name: Visual Direction
description: Camera angles, framing, composition, lighting and atmosphere that Visual Direction chooses per Dataset image for what the brief leaves open. Directions say how an image is seen and lit, never what is in it; retrieval never offers them as scene content.

categories.name: Camera angles
categories.description: Where the image is seen from.

categories.name: Framing
categories.description: How much of the subjects and their surroundings the image shows.

categories.name: Composition
categories.description: How the subjects are arranged within the frame.

categories.name: Lighting
categories.description: Where the light comes from and its quality.

categories.name: Atmosphere
categories.description: Air, focus and surface effects around the subjects.
